exposure: Laparoscopic slip knot with purse-string suture technique
Cornual resection or cornuostomy with conventional sutures and knots
outcome: Postoperative complications (uterus rupture, persistent ectopic pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 13 patients with unruptured heterotopic interstitial pregnancies who underwent laparoscopy in the study hospital between May 2012 and August 2018, with 3 patients in the study group and 10 in the control group.
finding: The laparoscopic slip knot with purse-string suture technique significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss by 138 ml compared to conventional methods in the surgical management of unruptured heterotopic interstitial pregnancies.
